title: nymphaea lutea f. tenella
intro: Nymphaea lutea f. tenella, commonly known as the small yellow water lily or small yellow lotus, is a variant of the Nymphaea lutea plant, a species of water lily. This aquatic plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. Its therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its anti-inflammatory, sedative, and anxiolytic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Nymphaea lutea f. tenella include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
